title: His role on Danny White's recordings
summary: Plays on all White's records but arranged only I Surrender.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Were you involved with any of Danny's hit records, hit records? Kiss DeMar, Goodbye, or? Yeah I'm playing on them. You're playing on Kiss DeMar? I'm playing on all his records. All of his records? All of them, yeah.
But I only did one recording for him. As an arranger?

I used to do all his copying, you know, like all, but as far as any recording I only did one, that was one called I Surrender. I got it in my band now, you know. I Surrender. The rest of them Wardell Cazell did. He did the Raymond on Kiss DeMar Goodbye and all the rest of his song.
